findings: Both DP arrays are initially true exactly at threshold0. Each list-comprehension RHS reads the previous prefix array before assignment, so one operation increases its own count by exactly1.
Operation=true denotes AND; neg(operation) denotes OR. Each state encodes count>=threshold, not count=threshold.
Both lower bounds are guarded by first_target_flags[g], so all required counted gates must lie before or at the earliest original exact output. Padding cannot satisfy a missing count.
The negative-row list contains all maximal independent sets of each current catalog graph; n minus the largest such set is its vertex-cover number.
(m-1).bit_length() equals ceil(log2(m)) for the positive counts used here. All current catalog graphs are nonempty and C4-free, as independently reviewed in graph controls.
AND bound uses accepted216 and217: max(ceil(log2(numberMIS)),min(5,tau)). OR bound is the proper-backward-binary De Morgan dual of216 on the edge minimaltrue assignments.
Final witness replay checks both counts in gates[:first_target_gate+1], matching the CNF scope.
scope: Count cuts apply to every exact prefix, independently of minimality/profile. Other sensitivity/dominance cuts retain their separately reviewed global-minimum limitations. This review does not authorize adding non-C4-free or edgeless graph datasets without adapting the bound assumptions.
